title: Market shopping list
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: My grandparents and relatives; the market; Ramadan and Eid
source: Seeded from arabic/y3 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: market shopping list)
intro: Lesson 15: I go to the market: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ. To understand how to say where I go and what I buy at the market in Arabic

questions.q: Say: I go to the market.
questions.model: Teacher builds it: أَذْهَبُ (I go) + إِلَى (to) + السُّوقِ (the market). Pupils repeat each part, then the whole.

questions.q: Write a shopping list on the pupil PDF: five foods in Arabic, then two sentences: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ. أَشْتَرِي ... Read them to your partner.
questions.a: Five food words and two correct sentences
questions.model: Teacher writes: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ. أَشْتَرِي خُبْزًا وَحَلِيبًا.

questions.q: add who you go with: مَعَ أَبِي (with my father).
Back to our ponder: which three words would you need?
